title: Variance of a parametrized function
statement: For every real number $t$, the function on the three-dimensional sign cube given by $f_t(x)=\frac{t+1}{4}+\frac{t}{4}x_1+\frac{t}{4}x_2-\frac14x_0x_1+\frac14x_0x_2+\frac{t-1}{4}x_1x_2$ has variance $\frac{3t^2-2t+3}{16}$.
